summary: First full test run of the NakshatraVeda marketplace, backend and frontend. Two CRITICAL blockers were found and fixed by the testing agent: (1) the public preview origin was missing from CORS_ORIGINS, so the origin guard returned 403 on every browser POST, including login; (2) LoginIn.email used EmailStr, which rejects the reserved .test TLD, so all demo accounts got 422 at login. After these fixes, 30/30 backend tests pass (27 in test_marketplace_e2e.py and 3 in test_chat_extras.py). They cover: auth (register, admin-role 422, terms, bcrypt $2b$, httpOnly cookies, me/refresh/logout, lockout after 5 failures, origin guard/CORS); authorization (customer to admin 403, cross-customer booking/messages/birth-profile 404, astrologer cannot decide verification or change settings, privileged profile fields ignored); public listing gating; onboarding (upload PNG, 415 for text, submit, admin 5-min doc link and stream, reject then resubmit then approve, credential case separate); paid listing (failure leaves it inactive, success goes live with +30 days, buying again extends from current expiry); webhooks (bad signature 401, replayed event id duplicate_ignored with no new journals/entries, second captured payment for the same booking marked duplicate and auto-refunded); booking (server price snapshot ignores client price fields, same slot 409, audio 400, state machine 409/403, pay to payment_pending to confirmed); chat (participants only, live only, rate limit 429, admin read-only); early end by astrologer gives pro-rata refund; settle journal with 25% commission and available_at +48h; reviews (completed and joined only, one per booking, not-joined 403); dispute (refund > retained 400, valid refund creates reversal journal); cancellations (more than 2h ahead full refund, late 50% plus cancel_retain journal); payouts (over-eligible 400, one open payout 409, approve to processing, processed to paid with MOCKUTR, failed to reversal back to payable, trial balance ok); admin (list pagination/search/filter, unknown list 404, CSV, suspend user gives 403, suspended astrologer hidden, settings range validation, plan price edit audited, audit_logs entries); privacy (birth profile CRUD, future date 422, privacy toggle, export, deletion request with admin anonymise). Frontend tested with Playwright: landing, discover search/filters, astrologer page (audio/video disabled with the not-operational note), booking dialog with refund terms and terms checkbox, booking page accept, PayPage with MOCKED banner (success), late-cancel refund shown, customer account tabs, astrologer studio tabs, UI registration, profile save, doc upload and submit, admin verification review (doc link opens, approve), admin console with all 18 tabs, users search, CSV download, live chat send, end session, settlement display, review dialog, mobile 390px (no horizontal overflow, mobile menu works). All TEST_ data was cleaned up afterwards.

critical.issue: CORS_ORIGINS in backend/.env did not include the current public URL (https://guru-astro-hub.preview.emergentagent.com). It only had a stale 6bcba63f... host, so every browser POST (including login) returned 403 'Origin not allowed'. FIXED by testing agent by prepending the public URL to CORS_ORIGINS. Main agent should make this robust, e.g. always include the REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host or document it for deploy.

LoginIn.email was EmailStr. email-validator rejects special-use TLDs (.test), so the demo accounts demo.*@nakshatraveda.test could never log in (422). FIXED by testing agent: LoginIn.email is now str (3-254 chars). Register still uses EmailStr (fine).

minor.issue: Security: client_ip() trusts the FIRST X-Forwarded-For entry, which the client controls. After 5 failures (429), the same request with a spoofed 'X-Forwarded-For: 1.2.3.4' header returns 401 again, so brute-force lockout and all IP-based rate limits can be bypassed. Use the rightmost or ingress-appended IP, or also lock per email.

commission_report name is always empty: in {**r, 'astrologer_id': r.pop('_id'), 'name': names.get(r.get('_id'))}, r.get('_id') runs after the pop, so it returns None. The '_id' key is also kept from the **r spread. UI shows the raw id instead of the name.

The commission report under-counts: the late-cancellation settlement summary has no commission/astrologer_share keys, so retained commission from late cancels is missing from the report (it is correct in the ledger).
If no captured payment is found (pay is None), issue_refund(pay=None) raises a TypeError and returns 500. Return 409 instead.

Not retry-safe without transactions. If processing fails after the payment status flip (e.g. post_journal or move raises), the webhook_event is deleted for retry, but on retry the payment is no longer 'created', so the capture journal or confirmation is never applied. post_journal also inserts the journal header before the entries, so a crash between them leaves a 'posted' journal with no lines. Consider an outbox/repair sweep.

ui_bugs.issue: reload() sets loading=true, which unmounts the uncontrolled <Tabs defaultValue='profile'>. After uploading a document, submitting verification or buying a plan, the studio jumped back to the Profile tab, hiding the 'Submit for review' button. FIXED by testing agent: tabs are now controlled with useState (value/onValueChange). Verified in the UI.

issues: Only the Account and Debit columns are visible at 1920px. Credit/Balance are cut off because the long account names overflow the card. Add overflow-x-auto or truncate the account names.
The trial-balance badge reads 'Approved'. 'Balanced' would be clearer.
Astrologer column shows a raw id (e.g. 8fe1c6d1) instead of the name
Amounts show as ₹662.5 or ₹1,037.5. Use 2 decimals (₹662.50) or a consistent paise formatter.

Birth profile uses native <input type=date/time>, Slots uses native datetime-local and <select>, and the payout method and review rating use native <select> instead of shadcn Calendar/Select. They are functional but inconsistent with the design system.
The date has capitalize styling applied, so it renders as '2:26 Pm'
After a successful mock checkout the user stays on the checkout card with only a 'Back' button. Consider auto-redirecting to the booking/studio or showing a clear 'Go to booking' CTA.

action_items: Keep or confirm the CORS_ORIGINS fix (it must contain the active public URL). Consider deriving it so forks/deploys do not break login.
Keep the LoginIn.email=str fix (otherwise the demo .test accounts cannot log in).
Fix client_ip() to not trust the client-supplied first X-Forwarded-For hop (lockout/rate-limit bypass).
Fix the finance_summary commission_report name bug (pop order) and include late-cancel retained commission/share.
Guard refund_sub against a missing captured payment (avoid 500).
Make webhook processing and post_journal retry-safe (repair/outbox), since there are no multi-doc transactions.
Admin overview ledger table overflow, raw ids in admin tables, 2-decimal money formatting, shadcn Select/Calendar instead of native inputs, '2:26 Pm' capitalization.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py origin_guard plus a static CORS_ORIGINS list is brittle across preview forks (this caused the total login outage).
core.client_ip trusts X-Forwarded-For[0], which is spoofable and bypasses brute-force lockout and rate limits.
routes_admin.finance_summary: the dict-literal evaluation order bug always yields an empty name.
finance.process_webhook deletes the event on failure, but state changes are not idempotent on retry (the payment is already flipped). ledger.post_journal writes the header before the lines.
routes_admin.refund_sub has no None check on pay.
pytest.ini forces '-n 2 --dist loadscope'. The e2e suite shares state across classes, so run it with '-n 0'.

success_rate.backend: 100% (30/30) after 2 critical config/validation fixes; 5 minor issues open
success_rate.frontend: ~95% - all flows work; 1 HIGH tab-reset bug fixed; design nits open

Register emails must use a non-reserved domain (testmail.in works; .test is rejected by EmailStr at register). The API requires slots 30+ min ahead, so the tests insert slots at now+6/7 min into Mongo for start/complete. Studio tab-reset is fixed. Remaining open items are in action_items.
rca of the issue: Login outage: the environment was forked to the guru-astro-hub host, but backend/.env CORS_ORIGINS kept the old 6bcba63f host. Browsers send an Origin header on same-origin POSTs, so origin_guard rejected them with 403. Separately, demo logins failed with 422 because pydantic EmailStr (email-validator) rejects the special-use .test TLD. Studio tab reset: useApi.reload toggles loading, the early-return <Loading/> unmounts the uncontrolled Tabs, and defaultValue resets to 'profile'.
